items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 30 at 7:19PM EDT until November 4 at 7:00AM EST by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 5 to 8 ft expected.

* WHERE...South Santee River to Edisto Beach out 20 NM.

* WHEN...From 8 AM Saturday to 7 AM EDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
